instruction: Restore the recently closed browser tab.

metadata.explanation: Task requires agent to reopen the last closed tab (kayak.com) using Ctrl+Shift+T. Evaluator verifies all 3 travel booking websites are present in open tabs.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter 'get_open_tabs_info' correctly extracts all open tab URLs from Chrome via CDP
Metric 'is_expected_tabs' correctly compares actual tab URLs against expected URLs
Expected value correctly specifies the 3 URLs that should be present after restoration
Complete coverage: verifying all 3 tabs (booking.com, expedia.com, kayak.com) are present confirms the restoration was successful
State is directly accessible without postconfig - getter can query Chrome tabs at evaluation time
Logic will work correctly at runtime - setup closes kayak.com, agent restores it, evaluator verifies it's back
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor concern: The comparison may be order-sensitive via 'are_lists_equal'. If Chrome restores the tab in a different position than expected, this could cause false negatives. Consider using set-based comparison or documenting expected tab order behavior.
Consider adding logging to confirm tab order doesn't cause unexpected failures in practice
